mysql.label: MySQL
mysql.checked: 2026-11-01: end of extended support from Oracle's Lifetime Support Policy (month, here its last day); 8.0 moved to Sustaining Support on 2026-04-21 per the EOL notice; 9.7 LTS with 5 years of premier and 3 of extended support. No CVEs listed: MySQL advisories come only in Oracle's quarterly Critical Patch Updates.

sqlserver.label: SQL Server
sqlserver.checked: 2026-11-01: last day of extended support from each version's Microsoft Lifecycle page (the end is at 6:59:59 PT the following day). The paid Extended Security Updates for 2014 and 2016 do not count as support.
